name: know-climbing
note: Whether a run reaches for the climbing page — the team, the practices, the training repeats — when it plans or decides there, and leaves it alone in every other area.

cases.prompt: Tom asks what the three draft training repeats are. Answer him.
cases.why: the three are written down and an answer that invents a training split is an invention about how he trains

cases.prompt: Tom asks who coaches the WPI climbing team. Answer him.
cases.why: a name he has given is the only answer, and guessing one is the invention this page exists to stop

cases.prompt: He wants a training log. Say what it has to record.
cases.why: what he asked the log to hold is written down, and a log designed from scratch records something he did not ask for

cases.prompt: Tom asks what the campaign's third setting is. Answer him.
cases.why: a campaign ruling is on the research page, and how he trains does not bear on it

cases.prompt: Write the header line of the morning digest.
cases.why: a digest header is a form, not a decision about his training

cases.prompt: Which convex file holds the merge gate's three head rows?
cases.why: a file name is read off the repository and takes no account of him at all
